name: Cash Flow Frog
summary: Cash flow forecasting software for small and growing businesses that builds forecasts from connected accounting and bank data. Its vendor runs a hosted MCP server at mcp.cashflowfrog.com/mcp, listed in the official MCP registry, which it says can read and change a customer's forecast. Measured keyless: initialize answers 401 with an RFC 9728 Bearer challenge; the authorization server advertises dynamic client registration and PKCE S256. A paid subscription, with a trial.

payments.notes: Price set by annual revenue; monthly, annual and two-year billing; card payment. The pricing page fills its amounts in by script and a plain fetch carries none, so none is quoted. MCP access is included in a plan at no extra cost (vendor FAQ). 14-day trial, no card. No surface prices an MCP call.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-10 18:11Z, no credentials: POST initialize to mcp.cashflowfrog.com/mcp gave 401 and a Bearer resource_metadata challenge, scope cff.user. Its authorization server advertises dynamic client registration, PKCE S256 and public clients. A directory says API key; not what was measured.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim: weekly, monthly and yearly forecasts up to 36 months from accounting and bank data, plan-versus-actual comparison, and an MCP connector through which an assistant reads and updates the forecast. Neither job measure (error at 4 and 13 weeks, update latency) is published.
